svg.title: How Shopify resolves the market of a buyer and its customizations
svg.desc: A visitor request is matched against every active market. The most specific match wins, in the order company location, retail location, region, store default. A buyer with no match gets the backup region experience without checkout. The winning market inherits currency and price inclusions by override, and catalogs and web presences by addition, from its parent markets and the store defaults. The result is the currency, languages, URL, products and prices that the buyer sees.
svg.text: 1. Buyer signal
country from the URL, selector or address; company location; POS location
2. Match every active market, rank by specificity
company location > retail location > region > store default
Pocket Coffee, buyer in Spain: matches Spain and European Union, Spain wins
a child market is inferred when its region is a strict subset of the parent region
a market matched
no market matched
3. Resolve customizations up the lineage
winner market, then its parents, then the store defaults
overridden by the child: currency settings, price inclusions
added to the child: catalogs, web presences
several catalogs: only the highest precedence counts, lowest price wins on a tie
Backup region
experience of the
market that contains
the backup country
browse only, no checkout
4. What the buyer gets
presentment currency and rounding, languages and URL (domain, subdomain or subfolder)
published products and their prices, theme customizations, tax and duty display
